adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh call is now wrapped with `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zohocrm", credential.userId)`. In sharing mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`), `refreshOAuthTokens` returns the result of `fetch(...)`, i.e. a raw `Response` object (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). The subsequent code in Zoho CRM still assumes an Axios response shape (`zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error`), but `Response` has no `.data`, so `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data` is `undefined` and `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` will throw a TypeError when sharing mode is enabled.
